Patriarch of Serbia congratulates Archbishop Ieronymos on Anniversary of Ordination

Oct 05, 2026 | 09:23
in Carousel Front Page, Patriarchate of Serbia
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:46
Instaread

Patriarch Porfirije of Serbia sent a message of congratulations to Archbishop Ieronymos of Athens and All Greece on the anniversary of his episcopal ordination.

Addressing the Archbishop as his “dear brother and concelebrant in Christ,” Patriarch Porfirije recalled the day when “the grace of the All-Holy Spirit elevated” Archbishop Ieronymos to the episcopal ministry and extended his heartfelt wishes on the anniversary.

“We pray that you may continue to be a good shepherd of the flock of Christ entrusted to you and that the Lord may grant you all His earthly and heavenly blessings,” the Serbian Patriarch said.

Patriarch Porfirije also extended his fraternal greetings to the clergy and faithful of the sister Church of Greece, sending Archbishop Ieronymos “a kiss of peace and brotherly greetings.”
